data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawl' meaning night. The name Nawla is often associated with the beauty and brilliance of the night sky and the stars that illuminate it. In Islamic tradition, the night is a time of peace, reflection, and renewal. The name Nawla carries the meaning “Night, Star, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawla usually hope their child will grow to embody night, star, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
